$comment: Single source of truth for the crawlable /build-leaderboard sub-routes. Read by src/constants/routeMeta.ts (app) and scripts/generate-static-routes.cjs (prerender + sitemap) so slugs, titles and descriptions cannot drift. Slugs are PERMANENT PUBLIC URLS: renaming one breaks inbound links and loses ranking. Add entries, never rewrite them. See src/constants/leaderboardRoutes.ts for the accessors and for what happens when the ingest returns an encounter that has no entry here.
